title: The Mandala
seo_title: Mandala Charcuterie Board: Nine Rings & Shopping List
description: A mandala charcuterie board for 12 to 15: nine perfect rings of salami roses, prosciutto, Manchego, cheddar diamonds, berries and cucumbers around a whole brie.
hook: Nine perfect rings, one hypnotic circle, built out from a whole brie.
why: Each ring repeats one tiny pattern all the way around: salami roses, prosciutto roses, Manchego wedges, cheddar diamonds, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes and berries. Repetition is what makes it look so precise.
It's rated 3 of 5 because it only takes patience, not skill. A round board 36 to 40 inches across gives it room, and every guest can reach every ring.

timeline.what: Cut the white cheese wedges and cheddar diamonds, roll the prosciutto and salami roses, and slice the cucumbers. Store each separately.
Set the brie and build the rings from the center out.
Add the outer ring and the pomegranate star.

faq.q: How do you make a mandala charcuterie board?
faq.a: Start with a whole brie in the center and build rings outward, each one repeating a single pattern of meat, cheese or fruit all the way around.

faq.q: What size board do I need?
faq.a: A round board 36 to 40 inches across.

Make the meat roses and cut the cheese the day before. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
